SUTR-1 — SUTF

SUCS UTF-8, UTF-16 and UTF-32 framing.

The SUTF family frames 31-bit SUCS_CP values into byte sequences. All three are lossless over the full Base space.

Encoding Unit Covers Notes
SUTF-8 1–4 bytes Full 31-bit space Standard UTF-8 leading-byte framing; never emits a 4-byte value above 0x7FFFFFFF
SUTF-16 2 or 4 bytes Full 31-bit space Word framing with a marker bit (1 word to 0x7FFF, 2 words above); no surrogates — 0xD800–0xDFFF are valid PUA. Byte order explicit: BE canonical (sust16) or LE
SUTF-32 4 bytes (LE) Full 31-bit space One codepoint per unit; the only lossless framing for the native space

Reference implementation: modules/sutf. Data: Public/0.1.0/sutf/.
